translation:
The root is harvested in the eighth month, dried in the shade.

Original text of the Benjing: Loulu (Rhaponticum), bitter in flavor, cold. It chiefly treats heat of the skin, malignant sores, ulcers, hemorrhoids, damp bi (impediment), and promotes the flow of breast milk. Taken over a long time, it lightens the body and boosts qi,
